title: "CV"

Professor of Psychology at the University of Oslo, working on oxytocin
signalling, cardiac psychophysiology, evidence synthesis, and meta-science.

## Education

**PhD, Psychology** · School of Psychology, University of Sydney, Australia · 2010–2013

**Bachelor of Psychology (Honours)** · Department of Psychology, Macquarie University, Australia · 2003–2007

**Professor** (100%) · Department of Psychology, University of Oslo, Norway · 2025–

**Associate Professor** (100%) · Department of Psychology, University of Oslo, Norway · 2023–2025

**Senior Researcher** (100%) · Department of Psychology, University of Oslo, Norway · 2016–2023

**Postdoctoral Research Fellow** · University of Oslo, Norway · 2014–2016

**Clinical trial coordinator and research associate** · University of Sydney, Australia · 2008–2014
